newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai company exchange expands turnover.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai company exchange expands turnover.

text.p: The Shanghai Enterprise Exchange has traded 347 companies this year with a total turnover of 3.574 billion yuan, more than the combined volume of 1994 and 1995, the Wen Hui Bao newspaper said on Friday.
The exchange offers a market to auction and trade state and collective companies, the newspaper said.
Of the 48 state companies in Shanghai that went bankrupt in 1996, 38 were listed on the exchange and 29 were acquired, it said.
The number of exchange members has grown to 86, including foreign-invested financial institutions and firms from outside Shanghai, it said but gave no further details.
